claims: Harry Diamond is Rory McIlroy’s caddie.
Harry Diamond is a close childhood friend from Northern Ireland of Rory McIlroy.
Harry Diamond has been Rory McIlroy’s caddie since 2017.
Harry Diamond replaced J.P. Fitzgerald as Rory McIlroy’s caddie.
Harry Diamond and Rory McIlroy met at Holywood Golf Club as children.
Harry Diamond and Rory McIlroy are best friends.
Harry Diamond was the best man at Rory McIlroy's wedding.
Harry Diamond won the 2012 West of Ireland Championship.
Harry Diamond began working with Rory McIlroy in 2017 after a temporary stint.
Harry Diamond became permanent caddie for Rory McIlroy shortly after 2017.
Harry Diamond supported Rory McIlroy during the 2025 Masters.
Rory McIlroy has defended Harry Diamond.
